content:
It's time to look at our hand-picked selections of the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple has launched its all-new silicone case and TechWoven case lineup, with color-matched designs, alongside all our tried-and-true favorite third-party brands. Everything from brand-new burgundy options with built-in stands, to super-grippy customizable models, to premium leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods—you'll find it all here. We've also got budget-friendly options from value brands like Spigen, starting at just $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Updated 9/27: Added multiple exclusive discount codes for 9to5 readers.

Apple

  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe – Mulberry: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe – Light Blue: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe – Wine Red: $49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe – Navy Blue: $49

Featured Partner: ESR

ESR's all-new iPhone 18 Pro case and accessory collection has arrived, bringing premium color-matched craftsmanship, patented technology, and more highlights. The star of this batch of new releases is the latest Atelier vegan leather magnetic case, equipped with a zinc alloy Flex stand built into the camera bump protection area, offering 3× military-grade protection, and a "soft and flexible comfortable grip." Like other accessory collections, the new-generation Atelier is also available in four color-matched options, perfectly complementing the all-new Wine Red, Glacier, Black, and Silver finishes of the iPhone 18 Pro.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with Flex Stand $42 (orig. $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet with Stand (Grip version) $46 (orig. $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

When it comes to leather cases, Nomad is among the industry's finest, and their flagship models are now fully compatible with the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year, they've also launched a brand-new Rugged Case collection, with each color engraved with topographic patterns of Baja California:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 – $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 – $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Partner: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready to launch their classic Grip case, compatible with the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Beyond its clean design and super-grippy texture, it's once again compatible with a large selection of skins to customize your style, and there's also an extra discount when you add a compatible Prism screen protector to your new case purchase.

  • Dbrand Grip Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max $55 Customizable case, impact protection, super-grippy, crisp button feel
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 for iPhone 18 Pro/Max 2-pack $35 ($5 off with case purchase) Foolproof installation, auto-alignment, zero dust

This year, Dbrand is also launching their all-new MNML brand cases, starting at $39, featuring ultra-minimalist aesthetics, lower pricing, MagSafe functionality, and the crisp button feel the brand is known for.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Navy Blue, Tan, Wine Red

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro, Black: $14 (orig. $18)

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro, Blue: $19 (orig. $40)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case for iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Black: $19 (orig. $40)

SANDMARC

  • SANDMARC Pro Leather Case for iPhone 18 Pro $54 (orig. $60) Use code 9TO510 at checkout
  • SANDMARC Pro Leather Case for iPhone 18 Pro Max $54 (orig. $60)

****Note: SANDMARC products traditionally only go on sale once per year… unless you use the exclusive discount code above.

Bluebonnet

Bluebonnet is a small Texas-based shop specializing in handcrafted premium full-grain leather cases, featuring an edge-to-edge design—absolutely no plastic—paired with copper-plated metal buttons. We've also secured an exclusive 20% off deal for 9to5 readers on the brand-new iPhone 18 Pro cases:

  • Full-Grain Leather Minimalist iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Case $63 (orig. $79) Use code 9to5 at checkout

Luriax

  • The Signature Suede-like for iPhone 18 Pro $107 (orig. $120) Use code 9TO5 at checkout
  • The Modern Suede-like for iPhone 18 Pro $62 (orig. $69)

Arc

The 2026 Arc Pulse aviation-grade metal bumper case has officially arrived, with multiple new colors this year to match Apple's Glacier and Wine Red finishes:

  • Matte Black – $69.99
  • Polished Silver – $89.99
  • Polished Graphite – $99.99
  • Matte Light Blue – $119.99
  • Matte Deep Red – $119.99
  • Polished Gold – $129.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • iPhone 18 Series All-Leather Case $59
  • Colors: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • iPhone 18 Series Modular Case $59
  • A detachable magnetic back panel lets you switch between two modes. With the panel attached: full-grain leather case, slim and MagSafe compatible

Burton Goods

***Note: Use our exclusive code 9TO520 at checkout on the cases below for an additional 20% off the already-discounted launch price. If it doesn't work, try entering DUO10 at checkout.

  • Luxury Pocket Book Wallet Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max $89 (orig. $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case for iPhone 18 Duo $60 (orig. $80)

Alto Collective – Laser-Engraved Wood

  • Alto Laser-Engraved Wood iPhone 18 Pro Case from $33 (10% off) Use code 9TO5MAC at checkout Engraved Series Vintage Inlay Series Custom image upload

UAG

UAG has also launched a lineup of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including their signature rugged models, featuring reinforced corner protection, grippy bezels, and a variety of drop-protection-focused designs. If you're looking for a case built for rough use and everyday protection, UAG's lineup is definitely worth considering.

  • UAG Mouve $65 for iPhone Duo
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
  • UAG Civilian Anti-Slip Case from $60
  • And more...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you want a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with the usual suspects like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut lineup is worth a look. These cases pass MIL-STD-810H drop testing, offer reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating kickstand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a more premium but not too bulky case for the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't miss Mous. They're currently offering ultra-thin aramid fiber cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, with other recommended models below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fiber Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fiber Case $70
  • And more...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases lean toward a more forward-thinking design, featuring futuristic styling, slim profiles, and textured finishes that stand out among typical cases.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Case $60 for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are perfect for users looking for a slimmer option for their iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max. Their cases typically use lightweight aramid fiber with a clean, minimalist finish, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and adding reinforced protection at the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fiber Texture Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Aramid Drop-Resistant Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protection Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox has already prepared a lineup of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases, ranging from slim everyday options to more rugged, durable designs, catering to different protection needs. Many of the new models support MagSafe, and some add features like grippy sides, accessory storage, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, so you can pick based on your preferences for thickness and protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And more...

Belkin

If you're looking for a cleaner, lighter option than a fully rugged case for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, Belkin is also a solid brand. Their lineup typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases, with raised edges surrounding the screen and camera, and some models like Protect+ add reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2 Compatible MagSafe Grip Case $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Airbag Corners $60

CASETiFY

CASETiFY is another brand that typically jumps on new iPhone cases early, and their iPhone 18 Pro series is already available, offering a rich selection. The brand is best known for its colorful designs, bold prints, and protective cases that don't look overly utilitarian. Most models in the lineup support MagSafe, with clear, impact-resistant, and more fashion-forward options.

  • CASETiFY Ripple Silicone Case $56
  • CASETiFY Impact Ring Stand Case $64
  • CASETiFY Mirror Case with MagSafe $64
  • And more...

Speck

Speck's iPhone 18 Pro series continues the brand's consistent everyday-protection style with clean design. The lineup includes plenty of slim, grippy cases, as well as MagSafe-compatible models and clear designs, so you can show off your phone's actual color. These cases also offer good drop protection without making the phone overly bulky.

  • Speck Presidio Clear Grip Case $50 for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • Speck Presidio 2 Grip ClickLock Case with MagSafe $50
  • Speck CandyShell Icon Case with MagSafe $40
  • And more...

elago

elago cases lean toward a clean, minimalist design style, making them more budget-friendly compared to other options. The lineup typically includes slim silicone, clear, and MagSafe-compatible models, available in a variety of simple colors that perfectly match Apple's device finishes.

  • elago Urban Clear Case $14 (orig. $16)
  • elago Pebble Case $15 (orig. $17)
  • elago Ring Stand Armor Case $19 (orig. $25)
  • elago Ridge Silicone Case $19
  • And more...

  • TORRAS OrigArmor for iPhone 18 Pro $35
  • Ailun Screen Protector for iPhone 18 Pro 3-pack $7
  • ESR Armorite Pro Tempered Glass Screen Protector (2-pack) $30
